question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A woman having more than one husband at the same time
solution:
The correct answer is ***Option 3)***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Polyandry"** means a woman having more than one husband at the same time. (बहुपति प्रथा)

 
 
• **Example: *Polyandry*** is practiced in some cultures around the world, though it is quite rare.
 
 
 
• **"Polyandry" **refers to the specific marital arrangement where one woman has multiple husbands. (बहुपति प्रथा)
 
 
• **Example: **In certain regions of the Himalayas,*** polyandry*** is practiced to keep family land holdings intact.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the correct one-word substitute for **'a woman having more than one husband at the same time**' is '***Polyandry'.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Endogamy **(सगोत्र विवाह): The custom of marrying within one's own social group.

 
 
• **Example:* Endogamy i***s still practiced in many traditional societies to maintain cultural integrity.
 
 
 
• **Polymathy **(बहुश्रुतता): Knowledgeable in many different fields.
 
 
• **Example: **Leonardo da Vinci was known for his*** polymathy,*** excelling in art, science, and engineering.
 
 
 
• **Monogamy **(एकपत्नीवाद): The practice of marrying or being in a relationship with one person at a time.
 
 
• **Example: *Monogamy ***is the most commonly practiced marital system in the world today.
